name: Financial Instrument 110
definition: Identification of a security or other asset.

LineIdentification.name: Line Identification
LineIdentification.definition: Identification of the line of holding in the portfolio.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Specifies the quantity of assets to be transferred in units or in a percentage rate.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of the transfer. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the transfer as assigned by the underlying client.

CounterpartyReference.name: Counterparty Reference
CounterpartyReference.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transfer allocated by the counterparty.

BusinessFlowType.name: Business Flow Type
BusinessFlowType.definition: Business process in which the actors are involved. This will facilitate the right business process to be triggered, according to the market business model, which may require matching instructions (double leg process) or not (single leg process).

AverageAcquisitionPrice.name: Average Acquisition Price
AverageAcquisitionPrice.definition: Average cost per share of the security, including all fees.

TransferCurrency.name: Transfer Currency
TransferCurrency.definition: Currency to be used to transfer the holdings. Some transfer agents register holdings grouped by currency in addition to using the ISIN for multi-currency fund shares.

TotalBookValue.name: Total Book Value
TotalBookValue.definition: Net asset on the balance sheet, the total portfolio value minus or plus the unrealised gain or loss.

LatestValuation.name: Latest Valuation
LatestValuation.definition: Date and market value of the asset.

OriginalCost.name: Original Cost
OriginalCost.definition: Original amount paid for the asset at the point of purchase. May also be known as the book cost.

TransfereeAccount.name: Transferee Account
TransfereeAccount.definition: Account held in the name of the party that is not the name of the beneficial owner of the shares.|(Party and account into which the transferee receives the financial instrument from the transferor.)

Transferor.name: Transferor
Transferor.definition: Party and account from which the transferor delivers the financial instrument to the transferee.

IntermediaryInformation.name: Intermediary Information
IntermediaryInformation.definition: Identification of a related party or intermediary.

CrystallisationDetails.name: Crystallisation Details
CrystallisationDetails.definition: Number of units that have been received (crystallised) or not yet received (uncrystallised) from the fund. This is typically relevant to a pension fund.

TaxValuationPoint.name: Tax Valuation Point
TaxValuationPoint.definition: Date or tax quarter used for the calculation of tax on the asset.

SettlementPartiesDetails.name: Settlement Parties Details
SettlementPartiesDetails.definition: Chain of parties involved in the settlement of a transaction.

AssetsHeldInOwnName.name: Assets Held In Own Name
AssetsHeldInOwnName.definition: Indicates whether the assets are held in an individual’s own name.

TransferResultsInChangeOfBeneficialOwner.name: Transfer Results In Change Of Beneficial Owner
TransferResultsInChangeOfBeneficialOwner.definition: Indicates whether the transfer results in a change of beneficial owner.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the financial instrument.

AssetQuantity1Guideline.definition: If Instrument/Security is present, then Quantity/Unit or Quantity/FaceAmount or Quantity/AmortisedValue must be present.

AssetQuantity2Guideline.definition: If Instrument/CashAsset is present, then Quantity/CashAmount must be present.
